edits: recoloured the tile #000000 -> #26A69A (the mask-icon colour the page declares, and the teal of TimeRex's own wordmark SVG)
notes: DECISION: TimeRex has no app-mark SVG other than this Safari mask icon, which the company's own developer portal ships (its metadata says it was made with potrace, but the result is clean: an axis-aligned T knocked out of a rounded square, no fringe or stepped edges). Because the T is a knock-out, it shows the surface behind it: white on the light theme (exactly the app icon), dark on the dark theme (the app icon's T is white). If that is not acceptable, the alternative is the 'T' glyph alone from the wordmark SVG (developers.timerex.net .../timerex_developer_portal_logo.svg, element 0, #26A69A), which is a different, heavier T and not the app icon.
